vb_textbox.text: The main advice is to take a comfort break before you start as you will not be able to pause! Leaving the screen for 30 seconds would dramatically affect your score. I started off picking brown and purple and these served me well for a while earning up to 9 mushrooms occasionally. After a while the amounts dropped and the greens and grey became a lot higher so i picked those. Once you get a colour that is sending high amount keep picking it until the scores become low and then choose another colour and repeat
